description: Elections Commission - Declare the T. M. S. S. K. Thilakarathna was selected as the member of the Haguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
